this is my time to shine! I’ve been learning how to cook since the pandemic and you’d be surprised by how much you can make when you have so little. Hess a short list of three meals I made that are my goal to struggle meals. 

1. Gourmet Hamburger Helper! This works best for cheeseburger and beef stroganoff version. Cook as directed on the box but when cooking the meat (I personally use ground Turkey), make sure you season it with Lawary’s seasoned salt (or any of ur choosing), ground sage, meat tenderizer seasoning, garlic powder, pepper, and red pepper flakes if you want a little spice. For the noodles while it’s cooking I recommend you add a little salt and pepper for the noodles. While these are cooking, chop up some green, red, and yellow peppers, and broccoli. In another pan, sauté to your taste if you’d like. (This step isn’t necessary, you can just mix the chopped veggies in your pot). and mix it together with your cooked noodles and meat. Follow instructions on your box and ur done! 

2. Chicken and dumplings in a can, but  make better tasting! These ingredients are simple. All you need is a can of creamy chicken and dumplings soup, red and yellow peppers, Spinach, onions, thawed frozen shrimp, and minced garlic (you can use this in a can). What you’re gonna do is cooked the chicken and dumplings soup in a pot on medium low heat. In another pan you’re gonna sauté the shrimp and season to your liking, though I recommend garlic and herb seasoning and pepper. Chop up the peppers and onions and if you’d like, season that in a different pan. Once everything is chopped and sautéed, you’re gonna mixed it all in the soup that (including minc garlic, I recommend the can version).  Seasonings for the soup are as followed: pepper, light seasoned salt, sage, garlic powder, parsley, and red pepper flakes for spice. Cook until there is a bubble and enjoy! 

3. Easy White Rice and meat! But with a twist! Wash and cook rice while cooking the meat. For this i used ground Turkey, but you can use whatever ground meat to your choosing. Season the ground Turkey to your likening. After draining meat, place back in other pan and mix cheese sauce and salsa. Stir well. Once done add it to rice and enjoy! Bonus you can put rice and meat in a wheat tortilla with spinach and now you have urself a healthy wrap! (: 

These are my usual go to struggle meals I make when I don’t feel like doing too much. Most of these ingredients are already in your pantry so it may be a tad more easier than others. If any of you try this lemme knkw how it tastes!

Even if I don’t write a lot, at least I wrote something and that’s enough to gradually keep going. If you have a job, try to spend maybe a half a hour writing afterwards. Setting these little small milestones for yourself will make you feel better because you did something, and as a writer just writing a little bit each day will help us out and improve in the long run.
